editorial:
Imagine finding a beautiful princess frozen in a block of ice deep in the mountains. That is exactly how this wild ride starts. You get to meet Dr. Aikawa, a quirky guy who manages to wake up Princess Surya from her long nap. Once she is awake, the story turns into a funny and steamy race. Ryu, the doctor's son, falls head over heels for her instantly. He becomes obsessed with learning the 48 positions of the Kama Sutra just to impress her. It feels like a weird mix of a romantic comedy and an old-school adventure movie, making it a pretty unique watch if you are in the mood for something different.

What really makes this work is the blend of action and humor. While the romance is the main hook, the fights against the evil Mali Clan keep things moving fast. The animation has that classic 90s look that feels nostalgic and cozy. If you enjoy stories with a bit of spice and some goofy plot twists, you will love this.
endingExplained: The movie wraps up with a big showdown between Ryu and the Mali Clan. After a lot of fighting and chasing, Ryu manages to save Princess Surya from the cult's clutches. He proves that his love for her is stronger than any ancient spell or weapon. In the end, the couple finally gets together, and Ryu successfully masters the art of love, leaving the villains defeated and the princess happy in her new life.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves retro anime with a romantic and spicy twist.
